name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
summary: Karnitol's satchel waits in Ironforge for Roetten Stonehammer, who will pay you to carry it there.

sections.title: Back to Ironforge
sections.body: Kreldig Ungor sends you to take Karnitol's things to Roetten Stonehammer in Ironforge. Roetten will pay you for the work. With a laugh, Kreldig says Roetten may be so pleased that he asks you to join the Reclaimers full time. Travel carefully and without delay. Karnitol has little patience, though he is generous.

sections.title: In Ironforge
sections.body: In Ironforge, Roetten Stonehammer approves of the Karnitol business in Desolace. The chest was wrecked, but everything it held is here. Roetten leaves it to Karnitol to judge. The Reclaimers are relied on to find what was lost, not return it in fine shape. Then Roetten sets about paying you.

faq.q: Who do I deliver Karnitol's satchel to?
aliases: where do i take the satchel
faq.answer: Deliver Karnitol's satchel to Roetten Stonehammer in Ironforge.

faq.q: Who sends me back to Ironforge?
faq.answer: Kreldig Ungor sends you back to Ironforge and praises your work.

faq.q: Why is it important to deliver the satchel quickly?
faq.answer: Kreldig says Karnitol has little patience, though he is very generous.
Roetten Stonehammer is the Reclaimers' man in Ironforge. Business is booming for him, and he leaves smaller matters to his underlings.
